map.ARPU 50 元/月、毛利率 60%、月流失率 5%。LTV = ARPU×毛: ARPU 50 CNY per month, gross margin 60%, monthly churn 5%. LTV = ARPU×gross margin ÷ churn = 50×0.6÷0.05 = 600 CNY; with CAC of 200 CNY, LTV/CAC = 3.0 (a healthy ratio is usually ≥3), and the payback period = CAC ÷ (ARPU×gross margin) = 200÷30 ≈ 6.7 months.
map.月流失率用什么口径？: Which basis is the monthly churn rate measured on?
map.用同口径的期间流失用户÷期初用户。注意'月流失 5%'意味着平均生命周期约 20: Use churned users in the period ÷ users at the start of the period on the same basis. Note that 'monthly churn of 5%' implies an average lifetime of about 20 months (1÷5%). Definitions vary widely across businesses, so align the basis with your finance or growth team before substituting it.
map.LTV/CAC 多少算健康？: What LTV/CAC ratio counts as healthy?
map.常见经验是 LTV/CAC ≥ 3 且回收期 ≤ 12 个月较健康，但重决策、长: Common experience suggests LTV/CAC ≥ 3 with a payback period of 12 months or less is healthier, but high-decision or long-cycle businesses can relax that. The ratio is extremely sensitive to the churn assumption, so measure a range rather than relying on a single-point conclusion.
